Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04 NerdQaxe++ small quiet miner

Straight answer: the 40T is an 800 W box with real fans — fine in a garage or office, too much beside a bed.

For a bedroom I'd take the Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s at ~166 W, ~40 dB, $369. About $13 a month in power at your rate, and it's still a full block draw every ten minutes.
